julesThoughtProcess: I chose a vibrant cyber green (#00FF00) to represent life and resilience in a tech-driven world. The high-contrast 1-bit style emphasizes the gritty yet hopeful texture of everyday existence.
storyPanel: A street-level mechanic known as 'Gearshift' wipes grease from their brow, smiling as an old, repurposed delivery bot finally hums back to life. In a world defined by monolithic AIs and towering megastructures, true resilience is found in the quiet, stubborn act of keeping things running.
